about: The Local AI shelf (roadmap step 14). A copy ships with the add-on; a newer one is read from the public releases repository (local-ai/models.json) once a day while the app's checks are allowed. Sizes from Ollama's registry, licences from each maker's Hugging Face page, checked 2026-11-18; the search model is the 440m tag (text and pictures, 671 MB, checked on CJ's PC 2026-11-23), not latest (1.3 GB, which adds sound and video). Keep it small: the basic model, a few good ones per card size, the search model; anything else comes in through Other model.
